notes: *whither* read as one fusion of the relative, שָׁם and the directive he under rule 22's closing paragraph, which names *whither* among the pronominal adverbs whose one English word carries the resumption; the competing reading would mark the resumptive tokens unrepresented, which that paragraph forbids. Head on the relative per rule 22.
*them* at t023 is `added`: no object morpheme stands in the purpose clause, and rule 44 forbids folding a supplied object pronoun into the verb's unit.
The verbless opening gives the construction-supplied copula to the predicate noun מִצְוָה under rule 20, discontinuous around the article's *the* (rule 25), while זֹאת keeps only *this*.
